description: Use this when the user asks to create, write or save an art direction, or the board's New art direction asks for one: write it from their words, the chat and the board, and save it in the same turn. Saves it to the library and makes it the board's one art direction, replacing the previous one (which stays in the library). Fill every section with concrete, photographable choices. It applies to every look, so it names no garment, outfit, Model or Location (text naming a board item is refused). If the board has a brief, apply it with update_brief art_direction_id. If the result lists problems, fix them all and call again.

avoid.description: What never appears, one per line.

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

camera.description: Framing, angle, lens feel and distance (e.g. eye-level 50mm, full body with headroom).

light.description: Direction, softness, colour temperature and shadows (e.g. low warm sun from the left, long soft shadows).

mood.description: The feeling and the pose language: energy, expression, how the model moves.

must_keep.description: Rules every photo keeps, one per line (the user's own must-haves).

name.description: Its title, 2-6 words, the one you used in chat (never Untitled or Art direction).

overview.description: What the photos should feel like overall, in 1-2 sentences.

palette.description: The colours of set, light and styling (e.g. terracotta, sand, washed olive).

setting.description: Where it is shot: studio backdrop or place, surfaces, props.

styling.description: How the clothes are worn, hair, makeup, accessories, footwear.

variations.description: Only when the user wants variety across photos: each a name (Pose, Backdrop) and 2-6 complete alternatives Uwear rotates through.

name: save_art_direction
title: Save Art Direction
